fusions.name: Outstared
fusions.desc: Fixes your gaze on the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 arcane damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown Glare
fusions.desc: Flashes light off your scales in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 26 light damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Blunted] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Seen Coming
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds your armour rises by 18% and your dodge chance by 8%.

fusions.name: Watchful Overlap
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
